testsuite.name: run.trama.e2e.E2EExecutionQueryTest

testcase.name: inline runs with the same name and version execute their own graph()
steps endpoint returns steps in execution order()
steps endpoint shows forward and compensation phases()
step latency reflects the step itself, not the rest of the saga()
list filters by name and status and paginates newest first()
query endpoints validate ids and handle unknown executions()
step calls endpoint records rendered requests and one entry per attempt()
